item.title: Study: non-English languages can consume far more AI tokens, with the most expensive language using 1.5x to 5x more than the cheapest, causing a "tokenizer tax" (Ananya Bhattacharya/Rest of World)
item.description:
Ananya Bhattacharya / Rest of World:
Study: non-English languages can consume far more AI tokens, with the most expensive language using 1.5x to 5x more than the cheapest, causing a “tokenizer tax”  —  Some languages require far more tokens for AI models to process, raising costs and reducing context for the people who use them.

Original (direct link): https://restofworld.org/2026/ai-tokenizer-tax-non-english-languages-cost-inequity/
